Ad Designer (Performance Creative + Video Editor)    Location: Remote (Able to accommodate CST time)    Reports To: Marketing Director    Type : Full-Time      About Carepod    Carepod is a premium humidifier brand originally designed in Korea, known for our stainless steel water tanks, filter-free system, and elevated design. We operate across US, Canada, and Australia, with strong seasonal performance in Q4 and continued growth year over year.    We are entering our next stage of growth and are looking for a performance-driven Ad Designer to help scale our creative engine.      Role Overview    We are looking for a highly skilled Ad Designer who can both design and video edit performance-driven creative for paid media channels.      This role is responsible for turning strategy into high-converting visual assets across Meta, Tik Tok, You Tube, and emerging platforms. You will work closely with our Marketing team to test, iterate, and scale creative that drives revenue — while emphasizing our premium brand positioning.      Key Responsibilities      Performance Creative Development Design static and motion ad creatives for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid platforms Develop multiple creative variations per concept (hooks, angles, CTAs, layouts) Execute rapid testing cycles based on performance data Translate growth briefs into high-quality, on-brand ad assets Develop creative aligned to seasonal campaigns    Video Editing & Motion Create short-form video ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 formats) Edit UGC into performance-optimized paid ads Add captions, motion graphics, overlays, callouts, and performance hooks Optimize pacing and retention for the first 3–5 seconds Re-cut and repackage winning content into multiple variants Incorporate voiceover, testimonial layering, and sound design where needed    Performance & Iteration Review performance metrics weekly with Growth team Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, and messaging Produce new variants based on data (not just aesthetics) Help build a scalable creative testing system Maintain an organized creative library with tags by angle, hook, and performance    Creative Strategy Collaboration Collaborate with Marketing team on creative briefs Repurpose UGC into paid formats Support product launches with creative concept development Contribute to creative ideation sessions    Required Skills & Experience 3–5+ years in performance-focused creative design Strong portfolio of paid social and digital ad creative Strong understanding of Meta ad formats Advanced proficiency in: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) Cap Cut / similar short-form editing tools Experience designing for DTC brands (premium preferred) Ability to balance brand integrity with performance urgency Strong organizational skills Comfortable with fast iteration cycles    What Makes You Exceptional You understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative. You know how to design urgency without feeling “cheap.” You can turn one piece of UGC into 10 different ad variations. You think in hooks and testing frameworks. You care about typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You move quickly but thoughtfully.    Why This Role Matters    At our stage, creative is the lever.    Media buying is only as strong as the creative behind it. This role directly impacts revenue growth, efficiency, and scalability. You will play a central role in helping Carepod reach our next major milestone.      How to apply    Please submit your resume in English as part of your application.

vagas.title: Demand planner
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Demand planner em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Join a team that values you. At Staff Right, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.      The Demand Planner is responsible for developing accurate sales forecasts, monitoring inventory health, and driving planning decisions across multiple territories and sales channels. This role serves as the link between sales, operations, and supply chain teams by translating historical performance, market trends, and business goals into actionable demand and inventory plans.      Who We’re Looking For:     3+ years of experience in Demand Planning, Inventory Planning, Sales Planning, Supply Chain Planning, or a related analytical role Strong experience with forecasting, demand planning, inventory analysis, and performance reporting Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets Experience working with multiple sales channels, including e-commerce, wholesale, retail, or marketplace environments Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail Experience creating reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking tools for business stakeholders Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills Experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, ERP systems, inventory management systems, or reporting tools is highly preferred Background in consumer products, apparel, retail, e-commerce, or a related industry is preferred Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines) Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer    Technical Requirements:     Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor) Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps) Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outage    Why You’ll Love Working Here:    Competitive Compensation    We offer a competitive monthly salary based on your experience and qualifications. vagas.title: Senior video editor - paid ads & performance marketing
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Senior video editor - paid ads & performance marketing em tubarão. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Video Editor (Paid Ads / Performance Content)    Talent Global LLC — Latin America (Remote)    Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract      About the Role    Our client (a US-based Creative Agency/Venture Studio) is looking for a hands-on Video Editor with strong experience creating paid ads content for social platforms. This role is focused on execution — editing high-performing ad creatives — not creative direction or broad AI production work. The client is scaling their in-house content team and is looking for editors who can move fast, follow briefs precisely, and contribute to a growing AI-driven workflow.      Key Responsibilities Edit short-form video ads for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid social platforms Work from creative briefs to produce polished, on-brand ad creatives Edit performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce style content optimized for conversion, not just aesthetics Apply strong pacing, transitions, typography, and hooks suited for paid ad environments Use AI tools within the editing workflow and stay current on new AI-driven editing/production tools Share relevant AI workflows or tool discoveries with the broader creative team Complete assigned edits independently and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, iterative environment Collaborate with the creative/marketing team on revisions and performance-based iteration    Requirements Minimum 6 years of hands-on video editing experience Direct experience editing paid ad creatives for performance marketing, DTC, or e-commerce brands Strong command of editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Cap Cut, or similar) Comfortable using AI tools as part of an editing workflow (nice to have: exposure to Runway, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Pika, or similar) Ability to work full-time, aligned with US business hours Strong portfolio specifically showcasing paid social / ad creative editing (not just general video work)    Ideal Candidate    This person is an editor first — someone who thrives on turning a brief into a finished, high-performing ad creative rather than driving concept or direction. They have real, seasoned experience in the performance marketing/DTC/e-commerce space and understand what makes an ad creative convert, not just look good. They're comfortable with AI tools as part of their toolkit and curious about new workflows, but their core strength is editing execution. They're reliable, fast, and can work independently within a full-time schedule.

vagas.title: Service delivery representative
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Service delivery representative em bento gonçalves. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Make this the place where you grow!      Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação, desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e Service Now, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,      Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.    Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.      Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!      Estamos em busca de um(a) Service Delivery Representative para atuar na gestão dos serviços de suporte de TI de um cliente estratégico. Este profissional será responsável por garantir a qualidade da operação, coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, acompanhar indicadores de desempenho, assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs contratados e promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de atendimento. Será o principal ponto de gestão operacional entre a equipe técnica e o cliente, atuando de forma proativa na identificação de riscos, definição de planos de ação e acompanhamento das entregas da operação.      Responsabilidades:     Gerenciar a operação de serviços de TI, garantindo a estabilidade e continuidade dos serviços prestados; Coordenar equipes de suporte técnico (N1, N2 e N3), distribuindo demandas e acompanhando a execução das atividades; Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs e KPIs estabelecidos contratualmente; Atuar como principal interface operacional junto ao cliente, conduzindo reuniões de acompanhamento e apresentações de resultados; Gerenciar incidentes críticos, problemas recorrentes e escalonamentos, garantindo rápida resolução; Elaborar e acompanhar planos de ação para melhoria contínua dos serviços; Monitorar indicadores operacionais, produtividade, qualidade e capacidade da equipe; Garantir a correta aplicação dos processos de Gestão de Incidentes, Problemas, Mudanças e Requisições; Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos, automações e redução de custos operacionais; Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico e profissional da equipe, promovendo feedbacks e acompanhamento de desempenho; Elaborar relatórios executivos e dashboards gerenciais para apresentação ao cliente e à liderança. O atendimento desta vaga será para alocação em um único cliente, sendo responsável pela gestão operacional dos serviços de Suporte de TI.    Requisitos:     Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em gestão de operações de TI ou gestão de serviços de suporte; Sólida experiência em operações de AMS (Application Management Services); Experiência comprovada com suporte SAP HANA/SAP S/4 HANA; Vivência na gestão de equipes técnicas multidisciplinares; Experiência no acompanhamento e gestão de SLAs, KPIs e indicadores operacionais; Conhecimento das melhores práticas de ITIL; Experiência na condução de reuniões executivas com clientes; Capacidade de gerenciamento de incidentes críticos e gestão de crises; Conhecimento em ferramentas de ITSM (Service Now, SAP Solution Manager, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy ou similares); Excelente comunicação, organização, capacidade analítica e perfil de liderança. Inglês Avançado (Desejável).    Contratação CLT    Atuação Remota        Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.     *Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Abm & b2b marketing specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: ABM & Revenue Operations Associate    Type: Part-time (with strong potential to scale to full-time)    Location: Remote    Schedule: Flexible, aligned with US working hours      About the Role    This is a hands-on execution role supporting Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and go-to-market systems for B2 B companies operating in niche markets.    You will work directly within a fractional consulting model, where strategy, execution, and iteration are tightly connected. There are no large teams or layered structures—only clear processes, defined systems, and a strong focus on impact.    The role is built for someone who can think analytically, execute independently, and contribute directly to pipeline generation through structured, high-quality work.      Role Overview    We are looking for someone who can operate across research, campaign execution, content production, and reporting.    This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for building and running key parts of the system: from target account lists and outbound sequences to campaign briefs and performance analysis.    You will have context, tools, and autonomy—but also ownership over execution quality and outcomes.      Responsibilities    ABM & Go-To-Market Execution Build and maintain Target Account Lists based on ICP, intent signals, and segmentation logic Conduct account research: map buyer committees, identify pain points, triggers, and competitive context Develop outbound sequences (Email + Linked In), including copywriting, segmentation variants, QA, and iteration Create detailed campaign briefs: messaging per persona/tier, offer, CTA, required assets, and dependencies Manage deliverables across campaign cycles, ensuring continuity and documentation of outcomes  Content & Deliverables Produce strategy briefs, one-pagers, and sales-oriented summaries Create slides and lightweight mockups for campaigns or client-facing materials Build reusable templates (messaging frameworks, research structures, briefing formats)  Reporting & Analysis Track and report on activity and performance: engagement by account, sequence performance, pipeline progression Identify patterns across campaigns: messaging effectiveness, segment performance, conversion trends Document insights and integrate learnings into future campaign cycles    Qualifications    Must-Have Experience in B2 B marketing, sales, growth, or similar execution roles Strong analytical thinking applied to real business problems Excellent written and spoken English (clear, concise, and business-oriented) Ability to work independently Strong organizational and documentation skills Experience using AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Claude) as part of daily workflows Ability to produce high-quality work with speed and consistency  Nice-to-Have Familiarity with ABM or outbound strategies Experience with tools such as Hub Spot, Apollo, Clay, Linked In Sales Navigator Proficiency with Google Sheets or similar tools Experience with Canva or Figma for basic visual deliverables Familiarity with Notion, Click Up, or similar documentation/project tools      What We’re Looking For An execution-driven operator who can both think and do Someone comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment A clear communicator who writes with purpose and precision Highly autonomous, proactive, and accountable Detail-oriented, with strong standards for deliverables AI-fluent: able to leverage AI effectively while applying critical thinking and judgment

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Global head of customer support em sumaré. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.      Key Responsibilities: Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives. Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth. Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments. Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap. Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers. Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently. Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including Fresh Service and equivalent service management platforms Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities. Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.    Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within Saa S or software businesses. Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time. Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Senior google ads specialist em pinhais. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Google Ads Specialist (DTC E-commerce)      Talent Global LLC – Remote      About the Role      We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Google Ads Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts for a California-based furniture company. This role is focused on driving profitable growth through Google Ads, with a strong emphasis on Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce marketing of physical products .    The ideal candidate has a proven track record of scaling consumer brands through paid advertising, particularly within e-commerce environments, and is comfortable managing campaigns across multiple advertising platforms. While Google Ads expertise is the primary requirement, experience with Meta Ads and other paid media channels is highly valued.    This is a part-time remote position with the goal of transitioning into a full-time role as the business continues to grow.      Responsibilities      Google Ads Management Own and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing. Develop, implement, and optimize campaign strategies to drive revenue growth and profitability. Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, bid management, and account structure optimization. Continuously optimize performance based on ROAS, CAC, MER, conversion rate, and revenue goals. Design and execute testing strategies for ad copy, landing pages, audiences, campaign structures, and bidding models. Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to scale efficiently. Manage advertising budgets and allocate spend based on performance insights. Ensure accurate conversion tracking, attribution, and reporting.    Multi-Channel Paid Media Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns when applicable. Identify opportunities across additional paid channels such as You Tube, Microsoft Ads, Pinterest, or Tik Tok. Develop cross-channel strategies that support customer acquisition and revenue growth.    Analytics & Reporting Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights. Build and maintain reporting dashboards and performance summaries. Collaborate with stakeholders to align advertising strategies with business objectives. Monitor attribution and customer journey data to improve campaign effectiveness.    Required Qualifications     8+ years of experience managing paid media campaigns. Extensive hands-on experience with Google Ads for DTC e-commerce brands. Proven success marketing physical consumer products through paid advertising.    Strong expertise in:   Google Search Ads Google Shopping Ads Performance Max Campaigns Remarketing & Audience Strategies Demonstrated experience scaling e-commerce brands while maintaining profitability. Deep understanding of key e-commerce metrics, including: ROAS CAC MER AOV Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution. Ability to work independently and make data-driven decisions.    Preferred Qualifications     Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns. Experience advertising furniture, home goods, lifestyle, consumer products, or other DTC brands. Experience working with Shopify. Experience with Google Merchant Center and product feed optimization. Familiarity with Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), landing page testing, and funnel optimization. SEO knowledge is a plus but not required.    Schedule      Part-Time (15–20 hours per week) Flexible schedule with the goal of transitioning to a full-time position.    Location: Fully remote.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

vagas.description:

Ad Designer (Performance Creative + Video Editor)    Location: Remote (Able to accommodate CST time)    Reports To: Marketing Director    Type : Full-Time      About Carepod    Carepod is a premium humidifier brand originally designed in Korea, known for our stainless steel water tanks, filter-free system, and elevated design. We operate across US, Canada, and Australia, with strong seasonal performance in Q4 and continued growth year over year.    We are entering our next stage of growth and are looking for a performance-driven Ad Designer to help scale our creative engine.      Role Overview    We are looking for a highly skilled Ad Designer who can both design and video edit performance-driven creative for paid media channels.      This role is responsible for turning strategy into high-converting visual assets across Meta, Tik Tok, You Tube, and emerging platforms. You will work closely with our Marketing team to test, iterate, and scale creative that drives revenue — while emphasizing our premium brand positioning.      Key Responsibilities      Performance Creative Development Design static and motion ad creatives for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid platforms Develop multiple creative variations per concept (hooks, angles, CTAs, layouts) Execute rapid testing cycles based on performance data Translate growth briefs into high-quality, on-brand ad assets Develop creative aligned to seasonal campaigns    Video Editing & Motion Create short-form video ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 formats) Edit UGC into performance-optimized paid ads Add captions, motion graphics, overlays, callouts, and performance hooks Optimize pacing and retention for the first 3–5 seconds Re-cut and repackage winning content into multiple variants Incorporate voiceover, testimonial layering, and sound design where needed    Performance & Iteration Review performance metrics weekly with Growth team Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, and messaging Produce new variants based on data (not just aesthetics) Help build a scalable creative testing system Maintain an organized creative library with tags by angle, hook, and performance    Creative Strategy Collaboration Collaborate with Marketing team on creative briefs Repurpose UGC into paid formats Support product launches with creative concept development Contribute to creative ideation sessions    Required Skills & Experience 3–5+ years in performance-focused creative design Strong portfolio of paid social and digital ad creative Strong understanding of Meta ad formats Advanced proficiency in: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) Cap Cut / similar short-form editing tools Experience designing for DTC brands (premium preferred) Ability to balance brand integrity with performance urgency Strong organizational skills Comfortable with fast iteration cycles    What Makes You Exceptional You understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative. You know how to design urgency without feeling “cheap.” You can turn one piece of UGC into 10 different ad variations. You think in hooks and testing frameworks. You care about typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You move quickly but thoughtfully.    Why This Role Matters    At our stage, creative is the lever.    Media buying is only as strong as the creative behind it. This role directly impacts revenue growth, efficiency, and scalability. You will play a central role in helping Carepod reach our next major milestone.      How to apply    Please submit your resume in English as part of your application.

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Service delivery representative em campo bom. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Make this the place where you grow!      Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação, desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e Service Now, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,      Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.    Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.      Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!      Estamos em busca de um(a) Service Delivery Representative para atuar na gestão dos serviços de suporte de TI de um cliente estratégico. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

vagas.title: Investidor
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Investidor em rio do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

This role is focused on execution — editing high-performing ad creatives — not creative direction or broad AI production work. The client is scaling their in-house content team and is looking for editors who can move fast, follow briefs precisely, and contribute to a growing AI-driven workflow.      Key Responsibilities Edit short-form video ads for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid social platforms Work from creative briefs to produce polished, on-brand ad creatives Edit performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce style content optimized for conversion, not just aesthetics Apply strong pacing, transitions, typography, and hooks suited for paid ad environments Use AI tools within the editing workflow and stay current on new AI-driven editing/production tools Share relevant AI workflows or tool discoveries with the broader creative team Complete assigned edits independently and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, iterative environment Collaborate with the creative/marketing team on revisions and performance-based iteration    Requirements Minimum 6 years of hands-on video editing experience Direct experience editing paid ad creatives for performance marketing, DTC, or e-commerce brands Strong command of editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Cap Cut, or similar) Comfortable using AI tools as part of an editing workflow (nice to have: exposure to Runway, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Pika, or similar) Ability to work full-time, aligned with US business hours Strong portfolio specifically showcasing paid social / ad creative editing (not just general video work)    Ideal Candidate    This person is an editor first — someone who thrives on turning a brief into a finished, high-performing ad creative rather than driving concept or direction. vagas.title: Investidor
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Investidor em arapongas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

vagas.title: Customer support specialist - brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Customer support specialist - brazil em itupeva. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Abm & b2b marketing specialist em anápolis. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: ABM & Revenue Operations Associate    Type: Part-time (with strong potential to scale to full-time)    Location: Remote    Schedule: Flexible, aligned with US working hours      About the Role    This is a hands-on execution role supporting Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and go-to-market systems for B2 B companies operating in niche markets.    You will work directly within a fractional consulting model, where strategy, execution, and iteration are tightly connected. There are no large teams or layered structures—only clear processes, defined systems, and a strong focus on impact.    The role is built for someone who can think analytically, execute independently, and contribute directly to pipeline generation through structured, high-quality work.      Role Overview    We are looking for someone who can operate across research, campaign execution, content production, and reporting.    This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for building and running key parts of the system: from target account lists and outbound sequences to campaign briefs and performance analysis. This role is responsible for turning strategy into high-converting visual assets across Meta, Tik Tok, You Tube, and emerging platforms. You will work closely with our Marketing team to test, iterate, and scale creative that drives revenue — while emphasizing our premium brand positioning.      Key Responsibilities      Performance Creative Development Design static and motion ad creatives for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid platforms Develop multiple creative variations per concept (hooks, angles, CTAs, layouts) Execute rapid testing cycles based on performance data Translate growth briefs into high-quality, on-brand ad assets Develop creative aligned to seasonal campaigns    Video Editing & Motion Create short-form video ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 formats) Edit UGC into performance-optimized paid ads Add captions, motion graphics, overlays, callouts, and performance hooks Optimize pacing and retention for the first 3–5 seconds Re-cut and repackage winning content into multiple variants Incorporate voiceover, testimonial layering, and sound design where needed    Performance & Iteration Review performance metrics weekly with Growth team Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, and messaging Produce new variants based on data (not just aesthetics) Help build a scalable creative testing system Maintain an organized creative library with tags by angle, hook, and performance    Creative Strategy Collaboration Collaborate with Marketing team on creative briefs Repurpose UGC into paid formats Support product launches with creative concept development Contribute to creative ideation sessions    Required Skills & Experience 3–5+ years in performance-focused creative design Strong portfolio of paid social and digital ad creative Strong understanding of Meta ad formats Advanced proficiency in: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) Cap Cut / similar short-form editing tools Experience designing for DTC brands (premium preferred) Ability to balance brand integrity with performance urgency Strong organizational skills Comfortable with fast iteration cycles    What Makes You Exceptional You understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative. You know how to design urgency without feeling “cheap.” You can turn one piece of UGC into 10 different ad variations. You think in hooks and testing frameworks. You care about typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You move quickly but thoughtfully.    Why This Role Matters    At our stage, creative is the lever.    Media buying is only as strong as the creative behind it. This role directly impacts revenue growth, efficiency, and scalability. You will play a central role in helping Carepod reach our next major milestone.      How to apply    Please submit your resume in English as part of your application.

vagas.title: Investidor
vagas.description:

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Senior Google Ads Specialist (DTC E-commerce)      Talent Global LLC – Remote      About the Role      We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Google Ads Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts for a California-based furniture company. This role is focused on driving profitable growth through Google Ads, with a strong emphasis on Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce marketing of physical products .    The ideal candidate has a proven track record of scaling consumer brands through paid advertising, particularly within e-commerce environments, and is comfortable managing campaigns across multiple advertising platforms. While Google Ads expertise is the primary requirement, experience with Meta Ads and other paid media channels is highly valued.    This is a part-time remote position with the goal of transitioning into a full-time role as the business continues to grow.      Responsibilities      Google Ads Management Own and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing. Develop, implement, and optimize campaign strategies to drive revenue growth and profitability. Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, bid management, and account structure optimization. Continuously optimize performance based on ROAS, CAC, MER, conversion rate, and revenue goals. Design and execute testing strategies for ad copy, landing pages, audiences, campaign structures, and bidding models. Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to scale efficiently. Manage advertising budgets and allocate spend based on performance insights. Ensure accurate conversion tracking, attribution, and reporting.    Multi-Channel Paid Media Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns when applicable. Identify opportunities across additional paid channels such as You Tube, Microsoft Ads, Pinterest, or Tik Tok. Develop cross-channel strategies that support customer acquisition and revenue growth.    Analytics & Reporting Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights. Build and maintain reporting dashboards and performance summaries. Collaborate with stakeholders to align advertising strategies with business objectives. Monitor attribution and customer journey data to improve campaign effectiveness.    Required Qualifications     8+ years of experience managing paid media campaigns. Extensive hands-on experience with Google Ads for DTC e-commerce brands. Proven success marketing physical consumer products through paid advertising.    Strong expertise in:   Google Search Ads Google Shopping Ads Performance Max Campaigns Remarketing & Audience Strategies Demonstrated experience scaling e-commerce brands while maintaining profitability. Deep understanding of key e-commerce metrics, including: ROAS CAC MER AOV Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution. Ability to work independently and make data-driven decisions.    Preferred Qualifications     Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns. Experience advertising furniture, home goods, lifestyle, consumer products, or other DTC brands. Experience working with Shopify. Experience with Google Merchant Center and product feed optimization. Familiarity with Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), landing page testing, and funnel optimization. SEO knowledge is a plus but not required.    Schedule      Part-Time (15–20 hours per week) Flexible schedule with the goal of transitioning to a full-time position.    Location: Fully remote.

Job Title: ABM & Revenue Operations Associate    Type: Part-time (with strong potential to scale to full-time)    Location: Remote    Schedule: Flexible, aligned with US working hours      About the Role    This is a hands-on execution role supporting Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and go-to-market systems for B2 B companies operating in niche markets.    You will work directly within a fractional consulting model, where strategy, execution, and iteration are tightly connected. There are no large teams or layered structures—only clear processes, defined systems, and a strong focus on impact.    The role is built for someone who can think analytically, execute independently, and contribute directly to pipeline generation through structured, high-quality work.      Role Overview    We are looking for someone who can operate across research, campaign execution, content production, and reporting.    This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for building and running key parts of the system: from target account lists and outbound sequences to campaign briefs and performance analysis.    You will have context, tools, and autonomy—but also ownership over execution quality and outcomes.      Responsibilities    ABM & Go-To-Market Execution Build and maintain Target Account Lists based on ICP, intent signals, and segmentation logic Conduct account research: map buyer committees, identify pain points, triggers, and competitive context Develop outbound sequences (Email + Linked In), including copywriting, segmentation variants, QA, and iteration Create detailed campaign briefs: messaging per persona/tier, offer, CTA, required assets, and dependencies Manage deliverables across campaign cycles, ensuring continuity and documentation of outcomes  Content & Deliverables Produce strategy briefs, one-pagers, and sales-oriented summaries Create slides and lightweight mockups for campaigns or client-facing materials Build reusable templates (messaging frameworks, research structures, briefing formats)  Reporting & Analysis Track and report on activity and performance: engagement by account, sequence performance, pipeline progression Identify patterns across campaigns: messaging effectiveness, segment performance, conversion trends Document insights and integrate learnings into future campaign cycles    Qualifications    Must-Have Experience in B2 B marketing, sales, growth, or similar execution roles Strong analytical thinking applied to real business problems Excellent written and spoken English (clear, concise, and business-oriented) Ability to work independently Strong organizational and documentation skills Experience using AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Claude) as part of daily workflows Ability to produce high-quality work with speed and consistency  Nice-to-Have Familiarity with ABM or outbound strategies Experience with tools such as Hub Spot, Apollo, Clay, Linked In Sales Navigator Proficiency with Google Sheets or similar tools Experience with Canva or Figma for basic visual deliverables Familiarity with Notion, Click Up, or similar documentation/project tools      What We’re Looking For An execution-driven operator who can both think and do Someone comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment A clear communicator who writes with purpose and precision Highly autonomous, proactive, and accountable Detail-oriented, with strong standards for deliverables AI-fluent: able to leverage AI effectively while applying critical thinking and judgment

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Global head of customer support em embu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.      Key Responsibilities: Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives. Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth. Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments. Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap. Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers. Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently. Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including Fresh Service and equivalent service management platforms Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities. Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.    Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within Saa S or software businesses. Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time. Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management. Strong technical acumen across Saa S architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence. Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.    Preferred Qualifications: Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation. Familiarity with Fresh Service or equivalent enterprise service management platforms. Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale. Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).    This is a CLT role R$40-50 K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Customer support specialist - brazil em jaraguá do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).
