Make this the place where you grow!      Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação, desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Estamos em busca de um(a) Service Delivery Representative para atuar na gestão dos serviços de suporte de TI de um cliente estratégico. Este profissional será responsável por garantir a qualidade da operação, coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, acompanhar indicadores de desempenho, assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs contratados e promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de atendimento. Será o principal ponto de gestão operacional entre a equipe técnica e o cliente, atuando de forma proativa na identificação de riscos, definição de planos de ação e acompanhamento das entregas da operação.      Responsabilidades:     Gerenciar a operação de serviços de TI, garantindo a estabilidade e continuidade dos serviços prestados; Coordenar equipes de suporte técnico (N1, N2 e N3), distribuindo demandas e acompanhando a execução das atividades; Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs e KPIs estabelecidos contratualmente; Atuar como principal interface operacional junto ao cliente, conduzindo reuniões de acompanhamento e apresentações de resultados; Gerenciar incidentes críticos, problemas recorrentes e escalonamentos, garantindo rápida resolução; Elaborar e acompanhar planos de ação para melhoria contínua dos serviços; Monitorar indicadores operacionais, produtividade, qualidade e capacidade da equipe; Garantir a correta aplicação dos processos de Gestão de Incidentes, Problemas, Mudanças e Requisições; Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos, automações e redução de custos operacionais; Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico e profissional da equipe, promovendo feedbacks e acompanhamento de desempenho; Elaborar relatórios executivos e dashboards gerenciais para apresentação ao cliente e à liderança. O atendimento desta vaga será para alocação em um único cliente, sendo responsável pela gestão operacional dos serviços de Suporte de TI.    Requisitos:     Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em gestão de operações de TI ou gestão de serviços de suporte; Sólida experiência em operações de AMS (Application Management Services); Experiência comprovada com suporte SAP HANA/SAP S/4 HANA; Vivência na gestão de equipes técnicas multidisciplinares; Experiência no acompanhamento e gestão de SLAs, KPIs e indicadores operacionais; Conhecimento das melhores práticas de ITIL; Experiência na condução de reuniões executivas com clientes; Capacidade de gerenciamento de incidentes críticos e gestão de crises; Conhecimento em ferramentas de ITSM (Service Now, SAP Solution Manager, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy ou similares); Excelente comunicação, organização, capacidade analítica e perfil de liderança. Inglês Avançado (Desejável).    Contratação CLT    Atuação Remota        Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.     *Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

vagas.title: Global head of customer support
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Global head of customer support em valinhos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.      Key Responsibilities: Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives. Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth. Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments. Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap. Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers. Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently. Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including Fresh Service and equivalent service management platforms Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities. Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.    Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within Saa S or software businesses. Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time. Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management. Strong technical acumen across Saa S architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence. Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.    Preferred Qualifications: Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation. Familiarity with Fresh Service or equivalent enterprise service management platforms. Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale. Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).    This is a CLT role R$40-50 K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

For more information , click here .      Role reports to: Ger Financas Sr.      Location: Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos      Work Location: Hybrid      What you will do    Job Description      Kenvue Supply Chain Finance is recruiting for Finance Supervisor, located in São José dos Campos / Sao Paulo, Brazil.      The PICC (Principal, Inventory, Costing and Currency) Finance team is responsible for a great portion of the Supply Chain finance management, being in charge of leading the Principal Tax Intercompany Strategy, setting the Costing and overseeing Inventory for all the regions (NA, LATAM, EMEA and APAC). This team ensures that all supply chain/cost transactions, analysis and reporting are accurate and compliant in line with Kenvue guidelines.    The Finance Supervisor will play a key role in ensuring a high-quality service delivery model through strong collaboration across Business and Finance functions. In addition, understanding of the SC processes, systems and ability to effectively frame and communicate with senior leaders will be important to success and to the team as a whole.      The Finance Supervisor may work with Inventory or Principal pillars, being responsible for the following:      PICC Principal Responsibilities:  Oversee and manage intercompany transactions, regional pricing and profit elimination    Support tax strategy for principal sourcing companies with statutory and managerial P& L analysis being a key partner with the leadership for the Integration with Kimberly Clark    Coordinate and perform annual costing, ICP, markup setup process    Support development of financial forecasts, perform closing activities and analyses of results    Support analysis of Intercompany price variances    Influence the business to streamline the Principal flows and act as a key player on the principal deployment within the new S4 SAP Hana environment      PICC Inventory Responsibilities:  Oversee and manage the Inventory for the LATAM region being closer to the Finance Director and the Planning Director on the Inventory strategy for the organization    Lead the SLOB, FAA FP& A processes, DOS calculation, Net Inventory Reports    Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning to identify and mitigate risks (Regional and Global Planning Governance)    Partner closely with Finance teams (BUF, FP& A, Make, Source) to have a strong understanding of end-to-end costing variation and inventory drivers    Lead FAA analyses and closing activities for FAA supply chain groups    Lead forecast cycles to influence meeting inventory targets for a leaner supply chain      General responsibilities:  Ensure compliance with all local government and company regulations, policies, and procedures    Business partnering (i.e. Tax, Compliance, Supply Chain, Leadership Teams)    Share business and financial best practices/procedures across the region    Focus on process improvement and standardization    Promote collaboration and use best practices to provide strategic analytic support to the team and organization    Participate in other special projects as needed    Perform other duties as assigned    Lead teams      What We Are Looking For    Required Qualifications  A minimum of a bachelor’s degree is required in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or Business Management   6–8 years of experience    Cost and inventory accounting experience    Strong financial modeling skills    Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions    Ability to identify, recommend and implement process improvements    Ability to lead small teams      Desired Qualifications  Experience with SAP, Microsoft Office, and Business Intelligence tools    Experience as a Finance or related business partner    Advanced English preferred (Spanish is a plus)    Strong communication and presentation skills    Compliance background and experience      What’s In It For You  Competitive Benefit Package    Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Flexible Ways of Working & more    Learning & Development Opportunities    Employee Resource Groups      Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Customer support specialist - brazil em araraquara. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

Job Title: ABM & Revenue Operations Associate    Type: Part-time (with strong potential to scale to full-time)    Location: Remote    Schedule: Flexible, aligned with US working hours      About the Role    This is a hands-on execution role supporting Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and go-to-market systems for B2 B companies operating in niche markets.    You will work directly within a fractional consulting model, where strategy, execution, and iteration are tightly connected. There are no large teams or layered structures—only clear processes, defined systems, and a strong focus on impact.    The role is built for someone who can think analytically, execute independently, and contribute directly to pipeline generation through structured, high-quality work.      Role Overview    We are looking for someone who can operate across research, campaign execution, content production, and reporting.    This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for building and running key parts of the system: from target account lists and outbound sequences to campaign briefs and performance analysis.    You will have context, tools, and autonomy—but also ownership over execution quality and outcomes.      Responsibilities    ABM & Go-To-Market Execution Build and maintain Target Account Lists based on ICP, intent signals, and segmentation logic Conduct account research: map buyer committees, identify pain points, triggers, and competitive context Develop outbound sequences (Email + Linked In), including copywriting, segmentation variants, QA, and iteration Create detailed campaign briefs: messaging per persona/tier, offer, CTA, required assets, and dependencies Manage deliverables across campaign cycles, ensuring continuity and documentation of outcomes  Content & Deliverables Produce strategy briefs, one-pagers, and sales-oriented summaries Create slides and lightweight mockups for campaigns or client-facing materials Build reusable templates (messaging frameworks, research structures, briefing formats)  Reporting & Analysis Track and report on activity and performance: engagement by account, sequence performance, pipeline progression Identify patterns across campaigns: A Rich é uma empresa de cultura ímpar! Aqui, vemos o trabalho como uma saborosa sobremesa, um verdadeiro presente!Somos uma família em busca de pessoas que queiram viver uma experiência diferenciada com infinitas possibilidades de sucesso. Uma multinacional líder e pioneiro no mercado em que atuamos, oferecendo produtos e serviços no segmento de Confeitaria e Panificação.A Rich do Brasil detém um conhecimento global em soluções integradas para confeitaria com produtos (Congelados/Frozen e UHT). Ao adquirirem produtos da marca RICH’S®, os clientes recebem serviços únicos, que os ajudam a “vender mais e melhor”.Entender as necessidades dos clientes e atendê-los de forma diferenciada está no DNA de todos que fazem parte desta família, afinal trabalhamos com produtos que agregam valor à nossas comemorações, às reuniões de empresas, aniversários, indo do café da manhã até o happy hour.Nossa matriz no Brasil está localizada no Bairro da Barra Funda, temos 02 fábricas que estão localizadas em Sorocaba e Mairinque.RICH’S®, cuidando de sua confeitaria com o carinho de uma FAMILIA.Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa líder neste mercado?O nosso time de Recursos Humanos trabalha todos os dias para IDENTIFICAR, DESENVOLVER, PREPARAR E ENERGIZAR pessoas talentosas para alcançarmos resultados excepcionais!Somos uma empresa que detém o selo das melhores empresas para se trabalhar - GPTW e nos orgulhamos muito de todos os profissionais que fazem parte desta conquista!Se você está em busca de uma carreira plena e desafiadora e valoriza uma cultura corporativa familiar, nós temos a oportunidade para você! A Rich do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Rich Products Corporation e está fundamentada em valores sólidos que cultivam a inovação, o foco no cliente e uma atitude de sempre fazer o que é certo.Acesse nosso site e visualize nossas todas as nossas oportunidades de carreira, ou acesse diretamente o link: Gupy. Io/O que esperamos de você:Perfil de liderança, proatividade, senso de responsabilidade, foco em segurança e resultados, boa comunicação, capacidade analítica, tomada de decisão, organização e habilidade para atuar sob pressão e promover a melhoria continua;Principais atividades:- Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de utilidades;- Garantir a operação segura e confiável dos sistemas de refrigeração por amônia, chillers, torres de resfriamento e compressores;- Supervisionar as operações da ETA e ETE, assegurando conformidade legal e ambiental;- Garantir o fornecimento contínuo de água, água gelada, ar comprimido e refrigeração para os processos produtivos;- Planejar e acompanhar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas;- Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, consumo de recursos e eficiência operacional;- Promover melhoria continua, redução de custos e aumento da confiabilidade dos sistemas;- Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança e dos procedimentos operacionais;- Apoiar auditorias, gerenciar contratos de terceiros e acompanhar serviços especializados;- lnvestigar falhas e incidentes, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas;Diferenciais que buscamos:Experiencias Anteriores:Experiência em sistemas de refrigeração industrial por amônia, operação de chillers e torres de resfriamento. Conhecimento em ETA e ETE, sistemas de ar comprimido e utilidades industriais. Conhecimento das normas de segurança aplicáveis a refrigeração por amônia e meio ambiente;Formação Acadêmica:Curso superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Química, Produção, Elétrica, Automação e Controle ou Tecnologia em áreas correlatas, com foco em utilidades industriais, manutenção e processos produtivos;Agora olha só quais são os benefícios de ser um associado da Família Rich:- Vale Refeição/Alimentação - Flexível (pago inclusive nas férias);- Plano de Saúde;- Plano Odontológico;- Previdência Privada;- Seguro de Vida;- Totalpass;- Day Off Aniversário;- Horário de Trabalho: Segunda a Quinta das 08:00 ás 18:00 e Sexta das 08:00 ás 17:00 hrs;

Job Title: ABM & Revenue Operations Associate    Type: Part-time (with strong potential to scale to full-time)    Location: Remote    Schedule: Flexible, aligned with US working hours      About the Role    This is a hands-on execution role supporting Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and go-to-market systems for B2 B companies operating in niche markets.    You will work directly within a fractional consulting model, where strategy, execution, and iteration are tightly connected. There are no large teams or layered structures—only clear processes, defined systems, and a strong focus on impact.    The role is built for someone who can think analytically, execute independently, and contribute directly to pipeline generation through structured, high-quality work.      Role Overview    We are looking for someone who can operate across research, campaign execution, content production, and reporting.    This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for building and running key parts of the system: from target account lists and outbound sequences to campaign briefs and performance analysis.    You will have context, tools, and autonomy—but also ownership over execution quality and outcomes.      Responsibilities    ABM & Go-To-Market Execution Build and maintain Target Account Lists based on ICP, intent signals, and segmentation logic Conduct account research: map buyer committees, identify pain points, triggers, and competitive context Develop outbound sequences (Email + Linked In), including copywriting, segmentation variants, QA, and iteration Create detailed campaign briefs: messaging per persona/tier, offer, CTA, required assets, and dependencies Manage deliverables across campaign cycles, ensuring continuity and documentation of outcomes  Content & Deliverables Produce strategy briefs, one-pagers, and sales-oriented summaries Create slides and lightweight mockups for campaigns or client-facing materials Build reusable templates (messaging frameworks, research structures, briefing formats)  Reporting & Analysis Track and report on activity and performance: engagement by account, sequence performance, pipeline progression Identify patterns across campaigns: messaging effectiveness, segment performance, conversion trends Document insights and integrate learnings into future campaign cycles    Qualifications    Must-Have Experience in B2 B marketing, sales, growth, or similar execution roles Strong analytical thinking applied to real business problems Excellent written and spoken English (clear, concise, and business-oriented) Ability to work independently Strong organizational and documentation skills Experience using AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Claude) as part of daily workflows Ability to produce high-quality work with speed and consistency  Nice-to-Have Familiarity with ABM or outbound strategies Experience with tools such as Hub Spot, Apollo, Clay, Linked In Sales Navigator Proficiency with Google Sheets or similar tools Experience with Canva or Figma for basic visual deliverables Familiarity with Notion, Click Up, or similar documentation/project tools      What We’re Looking For An execution-driven operator who can both think and do Someone comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment A clear communicator who writes with purpose and precision Highly autonomous, proactive, and accountable Detail-oriented, with strong standards for deliverables AI-fluent: able to leverage AI effectively while applying critical thinking and judgment

Video Editor (Paid Ads / Performance Content)    Talent Global LLC — Latin America (Remote)    Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract      About the Role    Our client (a US-based Creative Agency/Venture Studio) is looking for a hands-on Video Editor with strong experience creating paid ads content for social platforms. This role is focused on execution — editing high-performing ad creatives — not creative direction or broad AI production work. The client is scaling their in-house content team and is looking for editors who can move fast, follow briefs precisely, and contribute to a growing AI-driven workflow.      Key Responsibilities Edit short-form video ads for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid social platforms Work from creative briefs to produce polished, on-brand ad creatives Edit performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce style content optimized for conversion, not just aesthetics Apply strong pacing, transitions, typography, and hooks suited for paid ad environments Use AI tools within the editing workflow and stay current on new AI-driven editing/production tools Share relevant AI workflows or tool discoveries with the broader creative team Complete assigned edits independently and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, iterative environment Collaborate with the creative/marketing team on revisions and performance-based iteration    Requirements Minimum 6 years of hands-on video editing experience Direct experience editing paid ad creatives for performance marketing, DTC, or e-commerce brands Strong command of editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Cap Cut, or similar) Comfortable using AI tools as part of an editing workflow (nice to have: exposure to Runway, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Pika, or similar) Ability to work full-time, aligned with US business hours Strong portfolio specifically showcasing paid social / ad creative editing (not just general video work)    Ideal Candidate    This person is an editor first — someone who thrives on turning a brief into a finished, high-performing ad creative rather than driving concept or direction. They have real, seasoned experience in the performance marketing/DTC/e-commerce space and understand what makes an ad creative convert, not just look good. vagas.title: Global head of customer support
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Global head of customer support em campina grande do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.      Key Responsibilities: Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives. Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth. Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments. Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap. Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers. Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently. Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including Fresh Service and equivalent service management platforms Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities. Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.    Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within Saa S or software businesses. Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time. Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management. Strong technical acumen across Saa S architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence. Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.    Preferred Qualifications: Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation. Familiarity with Fresh Service or equivalent enterprise service management platforms. Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale. Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).    This is a CLT role R$40-50 K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

vagas.title: Customer support specialist - brazil
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Customer support specialist - brazil em palhoça. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

vagas.title: Ad designer
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Ad designer em santana de parnaíba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Ad Designer (Performance Creative + Video Editor)    Location: Remote (Able to accommodate CST time)    Reports To: Marketing Director    Type : Full-Time      About Carepod    Carepod is a premium humidifier brand originally designed in Korea, known for our stainless steel water tanks, filter-free system, and elevated design. We operate across US, Canada, and Australia, with strong seasonal performance in Q4 and continued growth year over year.    We are entering our next stage of growth and are looking for a performance-driven Ad Designer to help scale our creative engine.      Role Overview    We are looking for a highly skilled Ad Designer who can both design and video edit performance-driven creative for paid media channels.      This role is responsible for turning strategy into high-converting visual assets across Meta, Tik Tok, You Tube, and emerging platforms. You will work closely with our Marketing team to test, iterate, and scale creative that drives revenue — while emphasizing our premium brand positioning.      Key Responsibilities      Performance Creative Development Design static and motion ad creatives for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid platforms Develop multiple creative variations per concept (hooks, angles, CTAs, layouts) Execute rapid testing cycles based on performance data Translate growth briefs into high-quality, on-brand ad assets Develop creative aligned to seasonal campaigns    Video Editing & Motion Create short-form video ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 formats) Edit UGC into performance-optimized paid ads Add captions, motion graphics, overlays, callouts, and performance hooks Optimize pacing and retention for the first 3–5 seconds Re-cut and repackage winning content into multiple variants Incorporate voiceover, testimonial layering, and sound design where needed    Performance & Iteration Review performance metrics weekly with Growth team Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, and messaging Produce new variants based on data (not just aesthetics) Help build a scalable creative testing system Maintain an organized creative library with tags by angle, hook, and performance    Creative Strategy Collaboration Collaborate with Marketing team on creative briefs Repurpose UGC into paid formats Support product launches with creative concept development Contribute to creative ideation sessions    Required Skills & Experience 3–5+ years in performance-focused creative design Strong portfolio of paid social and digital ad creative Strong understanding of Meta ad formats Advanced proficiency in: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) Cap Cut / similar short-form editing tools Experience designing for DTC brands (premium preferred) Ability to balance brand integrity with performance urgency Strong organizational skills Comfortable with fast iteration cycles    What Makes You Exceptional You understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative. You know how to design urgency without feeling “cheap.” You can turn one piece of UGC into 10 different ad variations. You think in hooks and testing frameworks. You care about typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You move quickly but thoughtfully.    Why This Role Matters    At our stage, creative is the lever.    Media buying is only as strong as the creative behind it. This role directly impacts revenue growth, efficiency, and scalability. You will play a central role in helping Carepod reach our next major milestone.      How to apply    Please submit your resume in English as part of your application.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Parceiro(a) de expansão — consórcios informais em caieiras. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Requisitos necessários: • Bacharelado em Ciências Farmacêuticas ou área da saúde. • 2 anos ou mais de experiência em indústria farmacêutica (áreas: marketing, médica ou relacionada). • Compreensão do processo de revisão e aprovação de material promocional. • Capacidade de conciliar vários projetos enquanto cumpre os prazos do cliente. • Habilidades de planejamento, resolução de problemas, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo/organização. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral. • Fluência em inglês: leitura, interpretação de texto, escrita e fala, pois trabalhará diretamente com o time dos EUA no dia a dia. • Altamente desejável: conhecimento do fluxo de revisão/aprovação de materiais no Veeva Promo Mats, incluindo ancoragem e anotação de referências. vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Customer support specialist - brazil em esteio. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

vagas.title: Investidor
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Investidor em maringá. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC. Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth. Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments. Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap. Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers. Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently. Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including Fresh Service and equivalent service management platforms Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities. Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.    Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within Saa S or software businesses. Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time. Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management. Strong technical acumen across Saa S architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence. Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.    Preferred Qualifications: Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation. Familiarity with Fresh Service or equivalent enterprise service management platforms. Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale. Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).    This is a CLT role R$40-50 K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

Both domestic and international.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

vagas.title: Investidor
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Investidor em carapicuíba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Customer support specialist - brazil em florianópolis. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).
